violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: EHS observed crepe spreader being stored in water between uses at 68F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE PROPER WAYS TO STORE IN-USE UTENSILS. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE REPLACE THE WATER THE CREPE SPREADER WAS BEING STORED IN, THEN SET THE NEW CONTAINER OF WATER ON THE FLAT TOP GRILL TO HOT HOLD AT 135F OR HIGHER BEFORE PLACING THE CREPE SPREADER INTO THE NEW WATER.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located to the left of the high temp dish machine is blocked by a plastic piece of equipment used within the dish washer, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT HAND SINKS CAN NEVER BE BLOCKED AND MUST ALWAYS BE AVAILABLE FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS AND PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. PIC REMOVED THE PLASTIC PIECE OF EQUIPMENT FROM THE HAND WASHING SINK.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken was being stored next to ready to eat deli sliced ham in the Everest 1DR UPR cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT RAW FOOD CAN NEVERE BE STORED NEXT TO OR ABOVE READY TO EAT FOODS. RAW FOODS MUST ALWAYS BE STORED BELOW READY TO EAT FOODS. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE RAW CHICKEN TO THE BOTTOM SHELF IN THE EVEREST 1DR UPR COOLER.
